ai_providers.disable_cooling_hint: Globally disable auth/model cooldown windows after failures.
ai_providers.cooling_policy_hint: Inherit global: no local override. Enable cooling: cooling stays enabled even when global cooling is disabled. Disable cooling: cooling stays disabled even when global cooling is enabled.
ai_providers.cooling_policy_legacy_hint: This CPA uses legacy cooling semantics and only supports Inherit global or Disable cooling. Upgrade to a build containing {{commit}} before using an explicit Enable cooling override.
ai_providers.cooling_policy_legacy_provider_unsupport: This CPA version does not support cooling overrides for this Provider. Upgrade to a build containing {{commit}}.
ai_providers.cooling_policy_unverified_provider_unsup: Cooling overrides for this Provider are unavailable because this CPA build cannot be verified. Use a build containing {{commit}}.
ai_providers.cooling_policy_unverified_hint: Three-state cooling support cannot be confirmed for this CPA build, so explicit Enable cooling is unavailable. Use a build containing {{commit}} or a later release.
ai_providers.rebuild_mid_system_message_hint: Move Claude messages with role system into the top-level system field before forwarding.
ai_providers.claude_request_fingerprint_hint: Keep the caller's prompt and headers by default, or opt in to the Claude Code CLI request fingerprint.
ai_providers.model_alias_scope_hint: These aliases apply to this API-key provider only. OAuth credential mappings are configured under Credential Management → OAuth Configuration.
ai_providers.thinking_levels_tooltip: Configure the explicit reasoning levels this model may use. When levels are not explicitly configured, thinking.levels is omitted; other existing Thinking settings remain in effect. CPA determines the model's final Thinking capability from the complete model configuration, so enable only levels confirmed to be supported by the upstream model.
ai_providers.thinking_required_error: Select at least one thinking level
ai_providers.thinking_unknown_levels_hint: This level comes from the current CPA configuration. CPAMP does not recognize it yet and will preserve it when saving.
ai_providers.openai_model_discovery_proxy_version_hin: CPA v7.2.130+ supports using the current key's proxy settings for model discovery and provider health checks; older CPA versions fall back to the existing credential proxy, global proxy, or direct connection.
